title: Threat Intelligence Brief — managed file transfer
subtitle: Advisory note for the InfoSec Assurance team
author: infosec-assurance-advisor

sections.heading: Summary
paragraphs: Two advisories affecting managed file-transfer agents were published in the last quarter. Neither is confirmed exploited against the assessed service, but **patch evidence is missing**.
bullets: Exposure: public SFTP endpoint restricted by IP allow-list.
Detection: transfer logs not yet ingested by the SOC.
Action: request patch evidence and complete log integration.

sections.heading: Recommendation
paragraphs: Proceed with conditions: obtain patch evidence before go-live and complete the SOC integration within the quarter.
